text: ひでんわざを　ぼうけんで　つかうときは　メニューの『ポケモン』から　ひでんわざ　を　おぼえさせた　ポケモンを　えらんで　つかいます。

structure.jp: ひでんわざを　ぼうけんで　つかうときは
structure.en: when you use an HM move in your adventure

structure.jp: メニューの『ポケモン』から
ひでんわざ　を　おぼえさせた　ポケモンを
structure.en: the Pokémon you taught the HM move to

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ひでんわざ　を　おぼえさせた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. ひでんわざ　を　おぼえさせた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you taught the HM move to'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making someone do it. Making a Pokémon learn is teaching it. おぼえさせた = 'taught'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: えらんで　つかいます
patterns.explanation: The て form joins two actions done one after the other. えらんで　つかいます = 'choose it and use it'.
